rationale: Frozen 2026-11-26 from the pilots (pilot seeds 9101, 9102; development role). Core: 20,000 cell parameters, the smallest budget, because the backpropagation control already shows a probe gain of 1.09-1.14 BPB there. E-prop: eta 3e-5 with max_core_update 0.001, the least harmful of the pre-registered configurations (Delta R -0.002 and 0.000; every larger eta was worse). Backpropagation learning rate 0.001: lowest probe BPB (3.027-3.035) and lowest held-out BPB (2.94-2.97) on the development role. novel_k 10: with 10^7 exposure bytes about 40% of development positions have a 10-byte context absent from exposure (6: 5.5%, 8: 18.9%, 10: 40.4%, 12: 62.4%, 16: 89.7%, 24: 99.6%; crates/zerolm-eval/examples/novelk.rs). Thresholds: h 0.5 is about half the pilot backpropagation effect (1.09-1.14) and nine times its seed spread (0.055); r 0.1 is far above the e-prop and perturbed-control seed noise (at most 0.02 in magnitude) and one tenth of the backpropagation effect; rho_min 0.1 is the same fraction; kappa_min 0.5 (the probe gain on first-source text must keep half its value after the second source); s 0.1 BPB excess late-window degradation of A2 over A1 and max_shared_window_fraction 0.01 are judgements, not calibrated on pilot noise (the pilot did not record window series or contamination fractions). Because the primary rule showed no pilot gain, r and rho_min test whether more exposure changes that; they are not set to be passable by a null result.
status: Frozen (version 3). Thresholds are never changed after the main run starts; a rerun after INCONCLUSIVE uses new seeds and a new hidden split, and a second attempt after FAIL needs a newly pre-registered rule (a new spec version).

history.pilot: reports/representation-pilot (pilot seeds 9101 and 9102, development role, 5e5+5e5 exposure bytes)
history.result_budget_20000: every e-prop configuration was harmful or unstable: probe BPB 4.135-4.482 for eta 0.003 against 4.113-4.176 for random features (A1), and 4.5-5.2 (probe) and 5.3-30 (held-out) for the two larger etas; the backpropagation control reached probe BPB 3.03-3.05 at lr 0.001 and 0.003 (a gain of about 1.1 BPB). The per-step update (up to 0.02 in Frobenius norm over 20,000 weights, 1e6 steps) was a random walk as large as the weights themselves while the random feedback is not yet aligned with the readout.
history.decision: version 2 pre-registers three smaller learning rates on the same rule; the larger etas were a configuration error, not a different rule

history.pilot: reports/representation-pilot-v2 (budget 20000 only; pilot seeds 9101 and 9102; development role; 5e5+5e5 exposure bytes)
history.result_budget_20000: no e-prop configuration helped: probe gain over random features (Delta R) -0.002 and -0.000 for eta 3e-5, -0.006 and -0.001 for eta 1e-4, -0.015 and -0.000 for eta 3e-4 (seeds 9101, 9102); the A2-perturbed control gave -0.002 to +0.002. The backpropagation control gave Delta R 1.141 and 1.086 (lr 0.001), 1.124 and 1.079 (lr 0.003), 0.802 and 0.710 (lr 0.01).
history.decision: the primary rule captures none of the headroom at this stream length. The optional second rule (error-free predictive) is NOT pre-registered: it is not required to reach a decision (roadmap Phase 9: P1 failing while A3 shows headroom leads to the written decision), and the main run on 10^7 bytes tests whether the failure persists at 10x the pilot stream. The 200,000-parameter budget pilot of version 1 (configs of version 1) was still running at freeze time; it cannot change the core choice because the smaller core already shows headroom.
